notes: Delete a channel: the bin on each channel, or at the bottom of New Vessel; type DELETE to confirm.
Pasting a channel you already have opens it instead of making a second one.
A pasted channel gets its real name and picture, and Juju watches its best recent film to learn from it.
A video link pasted where a channel goes says where it belongs.
The upload kit (title, description, thumbnail) opens on the phone and the web.
The Mac app signs in to the Door by itself and is on the same version.
